expectedIssues: Fastest near you carousel card heights are misaligned with each other
reportedIssues: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Smash Bros Burgers card sits about 28px lower than its neighbors. Its image starts around y=659, while the Green Bowl Poké and Trattoria cards start around y=631. As a result, its title and delivery fee also sit lower than the other cards' labels, breaking the row's shared baseline.

The favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently between cards. The Tokumaru Ramen Bar card shows a bare white heart icon, while the pizza card below shows the heart inside a dark translucent circle.
